canonical_source.author: N. K. Sinha

identity_verification.provider_metadata_notes: CIIL Bhasha Sanchika identifies N.K. Sinha, Mundari Grammar, 1975, persistent handle 20.500.14705/8179. Provider description states that the grammar is pedagogically organized by grammatical functions and covers noun morphology, verb morphology, adjectives/adverbs and syntax.
identity_verification.cross_manifestation: Bharatavani independently exposes a Mundari Grammar record for N. K. Sinha, 1975, naming CIIL Mysore as content partner and publisher and reporting a 117.39 MB PDF behind login-to-read access.
identity_verification.deduplication: Treat CIIL Sanchika and Bharatavani records as manifestations/catalogue records of the same 1975 work unless edition-level comparison demonstrates otherwise. Third-party mirrors are not independent sources. Repository code search for 'Sinha 1975 Mundari Grammar CIIL' returned no match before this audit.
